description: Client-side script for 'Loan Application' form in ERPNext, managing form setup, validation, dynamic field toggling, and related actions for loan applications.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initial setup for the Loan Application form, defining custom methods.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Refreshes form UI, sets queries, and adds toolbar buttons based on application status.

methods.name: repayment_method
methods.description: Resets repayment amounts and triggers UI toggles based on selected repayment method.

methods.name: toggle_fields
methods.description: Enables or disables repayment amount and periods fields based on repayment method.

methods.name: toggle_required
methods.description: Sets required status for repayment fields based on repayment method.

methods.name: add_toolbar_buttons
methods.description: Adds custom buttons for creating loan or security pledge if application is approved.

methods.name: create_loan
methods.description: Creates a loan from the application if approved.

methods.name: create_loan_security_pledge
methods.description: Creates a security pledge for secured loans.

methods.name: is_term_loan
methods.description: Hides or shows the repayment method field based on whether the loan is a term loan.

methods.name: is_secured_loan
methods.description: Marks the proposed pledges as required if the loan is secured.

methods.name: calculate_amounts
methods.description: Calculates pledge amounts and total maximum loan amount based on proposed pledges.
